ns2:course.label: Symphonic Band I
ns2:course.description: (MUSIC 281) Maintains a complete symphonic band instrumentation for the study and performance of all types of band literature. Open to all students who have been accepted by audition, with assignments made according to proficiency and instrumentation. Completion of each course involves, in addition to the regular schedule of rehearsals, participation in public appearances by the band. Prerequisite: Consent of instructor.
